messages:
maya s: Ran into a publish gate failure on release/1.14. regen-check reported a removed example bullet from CHANGELOG.md even though the sample app commit is present.

ci-bot: GH Actions · publish-typegen · FAILED
Job: regen-check -> non-empty diff detected
Logs: `CHANGELOG.md: removed line 'Example: auth retry pattern (sample-app)'`

dan o: I can repro locally. `yarn typegen` adds the line, but running `node scripts/changelog-cleanup.js` collapses it. The cleanup script has a dedupe pass that merges similar bullets.

maya s: weird — we intentionally added that example so semver-detector would pick up a minor bump. If cleanup strips it the bump disappears.

matters: small snippet from cleanup:```js
// remove duplicate bullets by content key
if (seen.has(key)) continue;
seen.add(key);
```

dan o: the key generation normalizes by removing parenthetical notes like `(sample-app)` to avoid dupes from contributor attributions. That makes the example indistinguishable from an older generic line and gets deduped.

ci-bot: typegen v2.5.2 · Generated files changed: CHANGELOG.md

maya s: short-term unblock: I pushed a tiny commit to append ` [sample-preserve]` to the changelog line so it survives dedupe. Re-running CI now.

release-dog: created issue #1601: "changelog-cleanup dedupe removes sample/example bullets causing semver false-negative" (assigned to dan o)

dan o: plan: update cleanup to treat bullets containing keywords `sample`, `Example:`, `sample-app` as high-fidelity and include parentheticals when computing key. I'll add unit tests and a fixture.

maya s: please also add a regendiff CI replay that runs `yarn typegen && node scripts/changelog-cleanup.js` in the same job image used for publish-typegen so we don't get different behavior between jobs. This would have caught the mismatch earlier.

dan o: will do. Adding `tools/regendiff-replay.sh` that sets NODE_ENV=ci and runs the exact pipeline steps. Also adding a CI check to fail if the post-cleanup diff is non-zero.

ci-bot: re-run triggered by maya s: publish-typegen · queued

manual note from maya s: after landing cleanup fix, remove the temporary `[sample-preserve]` suffix and re-run publish.

dan o: opened PR #1567: "fix(changelog-cleanup): preserve sample/example bullets and update regendiff replay" with tests and replay script. Marking for quick review.

release-dog: tagging release board. Suggest follow-ups: (1) add docs in devex about how cleanup treats parentheticals, (2) update sample-app generator templates to include `<!-- keep-changelog-example -->` sentinel so tooling knows it's intentional.

maya s: thanks — CI passed on the temp-preserve re-run. Once PR merges I'll remove the sentinel suffix and close the release ticket. :thumbsup:
